q-164225.name: Question 6
q-164225.problem: A TV set is $1\,m$ wide. What is this width in centimeters?
q-164225.worked_solution:
A table showing the metric units of length is given below.

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kilometer | $\text{km}$ | $1\,\text{km}=1\,000\,\text{m}$ |
| Meter | $\text{m}$ | Base Unit |
| Centimeter | $\text{cm}$ | $100\,\text{cm}=1\,\text{m}$ |
| Millimeter | $\text{mm}$ | $1\,000\,\text{mm}=1\,\text{m}$ |

So, $1\,\text{m}$ is equivalent to $100\,\text{cm}.$
